name: State Fragility and Insurgent Control
situation: Sahel and Horn of Africa instability

definition.question: How extensive is state failure, coup-driven instability and insurgent territorial control across Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, Sudan, Ethiopia and Somalia?
definition.low_end: Stable civilian governments with monopoly on force and insurgencies contained to peripheral areas.
definition.high_end: Multiple simultaneous state collapses with juntas and jihadist/insurgent groups controlling large territories and threatening capitals across the Sahel and Horn.

readings.rationale: Unassessed - no evidence in this batch on coups, junta consolidation, Sudan war, Ethiopia conflict, Somalia/Al-Shabaab, or territorial control. Would be higher with confirmed coup, major insurgent offensive, or capital threatened; lower with confirmed elections, ceasefires, or insurgent losses. Research needed: ACLED/conflict event data, coup/transition timelines, territorial control maps for…
